name: The Gift Of Tongues
overview: The Gift of Tongues is closely connected to the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, as indicated by the baptism with the Holy Ghost promised in Mark 1:8. The event of Pentecost in Acts 2:1 marks a significant moment when believers were united and empowered by the Spirit. Furthermore, Acts 10:44 demonstrates that the Holy Spirit falls upon those who hear the word, signifying that this gift accompanies the Spirit's work in believers.
